int_name: RISING SUN AVE & RISING SUN PLAZA DWY

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road in a commercial district with significant gaps in pedestrian infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to navigate high-speed vehicle traffic without protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, leaving pedestrians exposed while crossing a wide roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, providing no dedicated time for people to cross safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal pole at the intersection

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the road requires a long unprotected crossing time for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway spanning the center of the image

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and increase visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a commercial corridor with basic sidewalks but a significant lack of crossing infrastructure at the signalized intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps, creating a hostile environment for people attempting to cross the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks pedestrian signal heads, providing no guidance on when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal pole on the corner

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway and sidewalk transition areas create trip hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear timing for crossing maneuvers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with tactile warning strips to ensure accessibility for all users.

result.summary: This is a car-centric commercial environment characterized by wide asphalt surfaces and a lack of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure at a major entrance. While a sidewalk and curb ramp are present on one corner, there are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals to facilitate safe movement across the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks across the wide commercial entrance, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway entrance

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by vehicle traffic lights but lacks pedestrian-specific signal heads, increasing the risk of conflicts with turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light pole on the right corner

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the entrance road creates a long exposure time for pedestrians in the path of vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The wide asphalt area between the sidewalk and the opposite side of the entrance

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing phases and improve predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is a car-oriented commercial corridor with multiple travel lanes and no visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, the lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection creates a high-risk environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: No designated or marked crossing area for pedestrians at a signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Wide roadway
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway spanning the center of the image

hazards.name: Driveway conflicts
hazards.description: Multiple commercial driveways create frequent conflict points between turning vehicles and pedestrians on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the bank entrance

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint zebra-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads with countdown timers to provide safe crossing intervals synchronized with the traffic light.

interventions.title: Median refuge island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the road to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
